# QoL feature-set files that are synced verbatim (mapping-migrated) from the
# QoL source branch into every other version branch.
#
# This file is the manifest consumed by .github/scripts/sync-qol.sh.
# Paths are relative to src/main/java/com/stash/hunt/.
#
# Rules that keep this manifest honest:
#   1. Every line must exist as a source file under
#      src/main/java/com/stash/hunt/ on the QoL source branch.
#   2. The files are FEATURE implementations that are branch-agnostic apart
#      from MC mappings -- the whole file is overwritten with the migrated
#      version. NEVER add a file here whose content is version-specific
#      (e.g. a branch-pinned import that exists on some versions only).
#   3. Branch-specific metadata files (Addon.java, jefff-mod.mixins.json,
#      build.gradle, gradle.properties, mixins json) are handled SEPARATELY by
#      apply_manifest.py with idempotent inserts -- they are NOT overwritten.
#
# Last synced from: 26.2 @ 8df2d48 (TripResumer echo fix)
# TripResumer.java was added to the QoL set on 26.2 in 4fdf0de.

NewerNewChunksData.java
mixin/ChatComponentMixin.java
mixin/ClientPacketListenerMixin.java
modules/AutoEXPPlus.java
modules/AutoLogPlus.java
modules/TrailFollower.java
modules/TripResumer.java
